info.name: ReturnRight - BR 1.2 Not returnable (innerwear, perishables)
info.description:
Checks POST /api/v1/orders/lookup refuses innerwear and perishables whatever the date. Every order holds Cotton briefs (Innerwear), Organic honey (Perishables) and a Cotton shirt (Apparel).

Before running: load tests/api/fixtures/br_1_2_not_returnable_sample.sql into the database and start the API on {{baseUrl}}.

item.name: Day 1 - innerwear and perishables refused, shirt returnable

exec: const byCat = c => items.find(i => i.category === c);
pm.test('innerwear reason names the policy', () => pm.expect(byCat('Innerwear').reason).to.eql("Innerwear items can't be returned under our returns policy."));
pm.test('perishables reason names the policy', () => pm.expect(byCat('Perishables').reason).to.eql("Perishables items can't be returned under our returns policy."));
pm.test('no window date for refused items', () => pm.expect(byCat('Innerwear').window_ends_on).to.be.null);

item.name: Not delivered - policy reason comes first

exec: const byCat = c => items.find(i => i.category === c);
pm.test('innerwear shows the policy reason, not "not delivered"', () => pm.expect(byCat('Innerwear').reason).to.include("can't be returned under our returns policy"));
pm.test('shirt shows not delivered', () => pm.expect(byCat('Apparel').reason).to.include('not been delivered'));
